title: If the Sun Disappeared, Even the Air Would Fall

annotations.text: what if it never came back?
feel it go when we see it go
the whole day side goes dark
the Sun: just a bright star
the planets fade, one by one
~1/3 of the tide pull: the Sun
2007: 10 days in open space, and lived
today: Europa's ocean may hide vents like these
4.6 billion years old · ~5 billion to go
next: why is the Moon leaving?
